programme.title: CFL Football
programme.desc: The Tiger-Cats host the Elks in CFL Week 19 at Tim Hortons Field. Edmonton won the first meeting, 37-35, just two weeks ago. Hamilton has since bounced back with a road win and now gets a home rematch with few weeks left in the regular-season.

programme.title: CFL Football
programme.desc: The Ottawa Redblacks visit the B.C. Lions in Week 19. The Redblacks enter after a 34-16 loss to Tiger-Cats, extending their losing streak to 15 games. B.C. comes in following a 24-17 win over Toronto, marking their ninth victory this season.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 14 Missouri Tigers (4-1) face the Texas A&M Aggies at (3-2) at Memorial Stadium. The Tigers beat the No. 16 Gators 45-17 behind Jamal Roberts three TDs, while the Aggies beat the Razorbacks 34-7 behind two TDs from KJ Edwards.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Oklahoma Sooners clash with the No. 1 Texas Longhorns at Cotton Bowl Stadium in SEC play. Oklahoma relies on John Mateer following his 883 passing yards, while No. 1 Texas counts on Arch Manning after his 862 yards and seven passing touchdowns.
